# Optimize overpass-proxy upstream handling (2025-12-05 09:57Z)

_**User (2025-12-05 09:56Z)**_

when there are multiple upstream URLs given to the overpass-proxy and requests are fired towards those, analyze:



1.How are those requests distributed and how can distribution be improved?

2.How are the upstream_urls monitored for availability and could this be done?

3.When an upstream_urls request fails (HTTP 500 or else) how is this handled and how can it be improved so that users get answers still fast.

4. how is cool-down managed? Can this be improved?

5. how is the maximum amount of requests per 24h managed per upstream_url?

```json
{
```
```json
  "plan": "# Upstream Handling Changes\n\n**Current state (refs: [&#96;src/upstream.ts&#96;](src/upstream.ts), [&#96;src/config.ts&#96;](src/config.ts), [&#96;src/stats.ts&#96;](src/stats.ts))**\n- Random selection among non-cooldown/non-blocked upstreams; no performance weighting or stickiness.\n- Failures (5xx/429/network) trigger a single fixed cooldown; daily-limit exhaustion triggers a 24h block; both are tracked in-memory only.\n- &#96;/api/statistics&#96; surfaces current in-memory pool state but resets on restart; no health probes or background retries.\n\n**Planned improvements (per new asks)**\n- Weighted load balancing: track per-upstream latency/success EWMA and pick faster/healthier upstreams more often; degrade weights for slow responders; respect daily limits (prefer fastest until quota hits) and optional light stickiness.\n- Distinct cooldowns: separate paths for (a) daily-limit exhaustion (24h block) and (b) HTTP 4xx/5xx/network failures using exponential backoff; store next retry timestamps separately.\n- Background recovery: periodic lightweight probes for failed/cooldown upstreams with jittered intervals to reintroduce them automatically after errors.\n- Statistics durability: keep &#96;/api/statistics&#96; up to date with weights, health, cooldown/backoff vs daily-limit block, next retry, and persisted counters so restarts don’t drop visibility.\n\n**Todos**\n- &#96;lb-weighted&#96;: Implement EWMA-based weighted picker (latency/success) replacing random selection; keep quota-aware fallback.\n- &#96;cooldown-split&#96;: Separate daily-limit block from error backoff with exponential timing; include next retry metadata.\n- &#96;bg-probes&#96;: Add background probes/retry scheduler for failed upstreams to rejoin the pool without client load.\n- &#96;stats-durable&#96;: Persist per-upstream counters/state for &#96;/api/statistics&#96;, exposing weights, cooldown/backoff, and daily-limit blocks."
}
```
